subject: Runbook dry-run & post-go-live smoke checklist — orchestration playback + rollback scenarios
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme-payments.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runbook dry-run request + network checklist for go-live

Hi team,

Thanks for taking this on. We want to run a full runbook dry-run ahead of our planned switch-over next Tuesday (2026-11-24). Primary asks from our side:

- Confirm orchestration playback (apply deployment steps in staging with canary rollback).
- Validate network ACLs, route table changes, and NAT gateway behavior for cross-AZ traffic.
- Post-deploy smoke acceptance criteria: key endpoints respond within 300ms; background KV replication stays healthy; no 5xx spikes in first 30m.
- Clear rollback triggers and verified rollback steps (3-minute fail-fast).

Do you have a proposed dry-run window tomorrow morning? We can provide a canary workload and customer monitoring access.

Attachments: customer-smoke-list.xlsx (scenarios)

Emily
Emily Zhao
Head of DevOps, Acme Payments
emily.zhao@acme-payments.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:02:14 -0800
Subject: Re: Runbook dry-run request + network checklist for go-live

Emily — thanks for the clear list. We can run an orchestration playback on Monday 11/23 at 09:00 PT; proposed plan below. Please confirm if that works for Acme.

Planned dry-run outline (high-level):
1) Pre-stage: lock infra changes, snapshot config (S3), pre-create route table changes in staged VPC.
2) Orchestration playback: execute orchestration-playback.yaml in read-only mode first, then apply to staging with canary labels.
3) Smoke validation: run the customer-smoke-list.xlsx scenarios against canary endpoints, collect latency/5xx metrics.
4) Rollback rehearsal: trigger controlled rollback using the runbook steps; measure time-to-rollback and validate state.
5) Post-run capture: upload playback-log.txt and smoke-report-summary.md to the shared folder.

Key notes:
- Attachments: redwood_runbook_v1.3.pdf (runbook), orchestration-playback.yaml, network-acls-20261118.csv.
- We’ll pre-stage a canary EC2 in the same AZ to validate route table/NAT behavior.
- Rishi will validate intra-VPC cross-AZ paths and any StatefulSet session persistence details.

If that schedule works, we’ll set up a 45min dry-run, followed by a 30min buffer for rollback drills.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

On Sun, Nov 22, 2026 at 10:02 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Key notes:
> - We’ll pre-stage a canary EC2 in the same AZ to validate route table/NAT behavior.
> - Rishi will validate intra-VPC cross-AZ paths and any StatefulSet session persistence details.

Adding a couple of operational caveats based on recent infra runs:
- Ensure routing policies for outbound egress to partner logging endpoints (10.44.0.0/16) are in the staged ACLs; we saw dropped traffic when a deny rule was pushed too early.
- Pre-stage explicit SNAT rules on the NAT gateway; variants in source port translation can cause session resets on short-lived gRPC connections.
- Have a fallback plan to re-route traffic to our dedicated test subnet (subnet-test-1) — add that to the runbook as a numbered step so on-call can run it without the orchestration UI.

I’ll run the cross-AZ traceroutes and validate BFD/peer timers during the 09:00 window and update playback-log.txt with timestamps.

-Rishi
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme-payments.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 12:07:55 -0800
Subject: Re: Runbook dry-run request + network checklist for go-live

Thanks — Monday 09:00 PT works. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Acceptance: we’ll sign off if all critical smoke scenarios pass and no 5xx spikes > 0.5% in the first 30 minutes.
- Rollback: our SRE wants the rollback to be callable from the orchestration UI and as a CLI step; please include both.
- Access: we’ll give temporary IAM read-only to the monitoring dashboards and a scoped service account for the canary workload.

I’ve attached the customer-smoke-list.xlsx that maps our critical flows to API endpoints.

Emily
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-run: orchestration playback + smoke results (summary)

Team — quick post-run summary from today’s playback and smoke validation. Attachments uploaded to the shared Drive and DocuSign folder: playback-log.txt, smoke-report-summary.md.

Summary highlights:
- Orchestration playback executed at 09:00 PT against staged VPC; canary deployed to subnet-test-1.
- Smoke scenario run: 24/24 critical flows exercised. Latency: median 210ms, p95 280ms. No 5xx spikes in the first 30 minutes (observed 0.02% transient errors attributable to a downstream partner retry issue).
- Rollback rehearsal: invoked from orchestration UI and via CLI. Average rollback completion: 2:40 (within the 3-minute fail-fast window for control-plane rollback; data-state rollback requires manual DB revert — documented step 7).
- Network notes: Rishi’s traceroutes show cross-AZ latency within expected bounds; SNAT mapping remained stable after pre-staging rules.

Open items (next actions):
- Add explicit CLI examples for DB revert step (owner: Laura).
- Update runbook section 5 with the fail-fast threshold and monitoring dashboard links (owner: Monica).
- Confirm production cutover window and DocuSign approval for maintenance (Emily to confirm).

Overall outcome: dry-run PASS for orchestration + smoke validation. Marking this ready for the scheduled cutover pending DocuSign.

— Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: playback-log.txt (text), smoke-report-summary.md (markdown)
